newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foshan Development Co loan increased to US$23 mln.
newsitem.headline: Foshan Development Co loan increased to US$23 mln.

text.p: Foshan Development Co Ltd's transferable loan facility has been increased to US$23 million from US$20 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said on Tuesday.
The borrower, Foshan Development Co, is a Hong Kong-incorporated window company wholly owned by the Foshan Municipal People's Government.
The loan has a maturity of three years and can be put annually. It pays a margin of 100 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a put waiver fee of 50 basis points if lenders do not exercise the put option.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 200 basis points to the one-year put.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are KIMB Finance and Standard Chartered Bank.

Senior managers are Korea Leasing (Hong Kong), with US$3 million, and Bank of East Asia's Guangzhou branch, Hongkong Chinese Bank, Kookmin Finance Asia, Seoul Leasing & Finance (HK) and Tat Lee Bank's Hongkong branch, with US$2 million each.
Signing is set for May 15 in Hong Kong.
